task: One shared RDF graph: qualified declarations, publication/coherence, threshold metadata and strict direct-comparison eligibility
identity: Normalize asserted named sameAs once across the graph and all external requests; preserve explicit difference; labels and equal numbers never imply identity.
focus: Every task focus is caller supplied. In-band shape/selector/schema/import declarations and aliases of any participating reserved vocabulary are rejected. All explicitly typed native participants require caller-selected catalog envelopes; envelope metadata cannot supply a missing native type.
joint_task_rules: The one requested threshold and both comparison results must select exactly the same normalized scale.

The threshold scale metadata and both selected results must pin exactly the same normalized scale version. Unequal unresolved identities do not satisfy this exact-join policy; no claim of physical incompatibility is inferred.
limits: Finite synthetic shared-graph fixtures only; no held-out/domain accuracy
Seven module families; selected relation endpoints only, not all 127 relations or full managed acceptance
No new HermiT outcomes or changes to the historical 359-row SHACL checkpoint
No source truth, clinical inference, governed organizational case admission or independent ratings
No risk score arithmetic, transformations, conversions, workflow transitions or interval reasoning
No change to model, manuscript, ORSD, SQL schema, owner decisions or frozen v0.3.1 assets
